title: Ben Totefet
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Shekalim, end of chapter 2, as appointed over the keys in the Temple.[^1]

notes.text: The Mechon Mamre digital text of Tosefta Shekalim chapter 2 explicitly lists Ben Totefet over the keys. Hyman’s end-of-chapter locator and office are retained, without importing other officials or establishing an identity beyond the supplied notice.
